profitability.breakEvenCpc: net validated attributable commission / paid clicks for the same cohort and currency
profitability.contribution: net validated attributable commission - ad spend - incremental variable costs
profitability.forecastModel: click-out rate × provider purchase rate × net commission per completed purchase; all inputs require evidence.
profitability.reporting: Pending bookings and click-out conversions remain provisional. Reconcile cancellations, reversals and consumed validated commissions. Consent coverage and mixed organic/direct traffic limit attribution. Do not call clicks revenue.
